translation.name: Iwaperite tajorentsi ikenkithatakoetziri awinkatharite Jesokirishito: owakirari inimotakiri tajorentsi

book.name: ROÑAAGAYITAKIRINI
book.title: ROÑAAGAYITAKIRINI JESOSHI JOWA OETARIKAPAENI AWIJATSINI IINJA OTHONKANTAPAAKYAARI KIPATSI

content: Roojatzi koñaatziro noñaakiri. Tema noñaawakiri ipokapaaki paashini ronampiri Tajorentsi, ipoñaanaka jenokinta. Osheki ipinkatharitapaaki, ishipakiryaapaaki, ikitejitaperotapaakiro kipatsi, rochookyaapaakina eejatzi nothaawantanakari.

content.text: “Rooteentsi ithonkaeyani maawaeni jeekaeyawitacharini Wawirooniyaki; osheki inashiwitani, osheki ipinkatharitawitani, rooteentsi ithonkaeyani.
Irira jeekapaentsiri kamaaripaeni inampityaawo, eejatzi mamawoniro, thoowoniro, peyaripaeni, maawaeni. Roshiyeeyakawoni rowaga tsinani, matakaapiintariri kaari ayi.
Tee okameethatawitani ojeeke, eejatzi iyotagaeyakirini maawaeni paashinipaeni atziri ikimiteeyantakaworini rirori.
Ranteeyakironi pinkatharipaeni; osheki raagaantaki riraga pimantzirori owetsikani, kyaaryo maawaeni rantayitakironi osheki kaari kameethatayitatsini. Tema amanantaperotaka osheki”.

content: Roojatzi nokemakiro Ishire Tajorentsi janta jenokinta, okantzi:

content.text: “Aapatziyeeyaririni Jesoshi pishitowaeyaneeni, rowaga nampitsiki: pikimitawokari, pantzirokari eerori kaari kameethatayitatsini antziri roori. Pikaateeyironikari, nowashironkagaeyiminikari.

Riyotzi Tajorentsi osheki rantapiintziro kaari kameethatatsi. Eekiro riyaatatye ikenkithashiryaakotero okaatzi rantziri, eejatzi royaakotziro kitejiri rowashironkaeri. Rooteentsi monkaatapaaka. Intsipaete rowashironkagaeri”.
Roojatzi ikantziri apaani ronampiri Tajorentsi inashiyitacharinipaeni:
“Paerani osheki owashironkagaeyakirini paashinipaeni roori, iroñaaka pipiyeeyaawoni, eekiro piyaateeyatyeeni powashironkaaperoeyerini. Tee okameethatzi anteeyakirini.
Iroka tsinani okenkithashiryaaka osheki okameethaperotaki roori. Tekatsi kimityaawoni. Osheki amanantakiro oethaari rooperori eejatzi othatanepaeni owaneenkayitantyaarini”.
Ajagaakawo ajankaneki okantzi: “Tema naaka kimitawori jewawenantatsiri. Osheki nokimoshiretaka. Eero netakotzimaetawo. Eekiro niyaatatyee niweshiryaawentyaawo”.
“Rootaki iroñaaka powashironkaantyaawori kameetha. Ari aashitakyaawopa otashe; pimantsiyatakaakiro; pikemaatsitakaakyaawo katsiri; ari picheraajagaakitanaki eejatzi ari pomiraakiro.
¡Omapokapaakya pitaya! Tema ishintsiperotaki Tajorentsi riraga kantakotantatsiri. Rootaki ikantakotziri ronampiri Tajorentsi”.

content: Riraga pinkatharipaeni antayitzirorini kaari kameethatatsi eejatzi ithonkatashitakawo tsinani iyorikite, iñeeyeroni otaaya, eejatzi iñeeyerori owachaarite; roojatzi riraakoeyaantyaawoni, rowashiretakotyaawo.
Inteena ikatziyeeyanakani; ithaawaeyanakini, raamaashitya rowashironkagaeyironi Tajorentsi rirori. Ikanteeyeni:

content.text: “O, wawirooniyajatzi, pashironkagaeyakaniwee. O, antawo pinampi, osheki pikaateeyawitani jeekaeyawitacharini.
Romapokapaakimi Tajorentsi, intsipaete ithonkaeyakimini, maawaeni”.

content: Ari riraakoeyakimini pimanteeyatsirini maawaeni kipatsi, rowashiretakoeyakimini. Paerani osheki piñaawenashiryagaeyawitawoni oetarikapaeni ipayitawitzimirini, omaanta eero iroñaaka pamanantee eejatzi.

Tekatsi ikantya ipimantemiro ooro, piraata, shipakiryaatsiri mapi, kitamaakiri mapi, riino kitamaari, kityonkamawori, jentamawori, kiraamawori. Tekatsi ikantya ipimantemiro taawirakota inchato kajankakotari, ajawaka raeki kitamaacheekiri riwetsikaetziro oetarika kameetha, pinatachari inchato riwetsikaetziri oetarika, kijotayitatsirini, pinatachari mapi.

Eejatzi tekatsi ikantya ipimantemiro majankapaneri eejatzi pochapaneri, tsipataapanetachari rowari, kajankapaneri, kajankaayitatsirini, awishoowaantsi oowa, oyeenka oriiwo, opane teriiko, teriikopaeni, waakapaeni, owishapaeni, kawayopaeni, shiyakomentotsipaeni, eejatzi atziripaeni; kyaaryo, ipimantayitzirini atziri.

Ikanteete: “Eero powawo eejatzi chochoki pinintawitari; tee okowanee pipaante owaneeya; paerani eeniro powaneenkatawitani. ¿Tsika pimaathaaganki kityonkamaworiranki iroñaaka? Tekatsi, taaka. ¿Arima pamanante paashini? Eero. Thonkakimi eeroka”.

Riraga pimantapiintawitaworini maawaeni iroka owaagawontsi raantapiintawitaririni osheki koriki; omaanta iroñaaka ikatziyeeyanakini inteena, ithaawaeyanakini, raamaashitya eejatzi rowashironkagaeyerini Tajorentsi rirori. Riraanakya eejatzi ishenkatanakya.

content.text: “¡Ashironkaamatsitemiini, wawirooniyajatzi!
Pashironkaakawee. Antawo naawita pinampi, osheki pikaatawitani jeekaeyawitacharini. Pikithaateeyawitakawoni riino jentamawori, kityonkaniromawori, eejatzi kiraamawori,
powaneenkaeyawitawoni ooro, mapi shipakiryaatsiri, eejatzi kitamaakiri mapi.
Romapokakimi Tajorentsi, ithonkitakimiro maawaeni, thonkapaaka”.

content: Eejatzi maawaeni marineero eejatzi ashiteeyaworini pitotsi aapiintzirori owaagawontsi ikatziyakoeyakyaani ipitoki inteena.
Inteena raminakoeyeroni owachaarite, teyariririri, roojatzi riragaeyantanakyaani. Ikanteeyeni: “O, okameethatawitani nampitsinta, tekatsi kimityaawoni”.
Osheki rowashireteeyanakyaani, rootaki imaeritantanakyaari eejatzi roeyotantanakyaari iitoki. Osheki riraakoeyakyaawoni eejatzi rowashiretakotakyaawo, ikaemaeyanakini:

content.text: “¡Ashironkaamatsitemiini! Pashironkagaeyatyeeyaaniwee wawirooniyajatzi, antawo naawita pinampi, osheki pikaateeyawitani. Osheki iyaatapiintzini antawo pitotsi janta, ipimantziro ashitawori osheki owaagawontsi, raantari osheki koriki.
Omaanta omapokanakya othonkanakya pinampi, maawaeni”.
“Pikimoshireeyanakini, maawaeni jenokijatzi: aapatziyeeyaririni Tajorentsi, rotyaantanewopaeni Jesokirishito, kamanantawitacharini, maawaeni.
Paerani osheki owashironkagaeyakimini, rootaki ipiyatakowenantakimiri Tajorentsi”.

content: Roojatzi noñaakiri ronampiri Tajorentsi, shintsiperotatsiri. Raakiro antawo mapi, rookakiro antawokiroña inkaare, poog. Ikantzi:

content.text: “Nowiinkakiro mapi, peyaperotaka; tekatsi ñeeroni eejatzi. Eejatzi ikimiiteero Wawirooniya, ithonkaeteero roori, thonkapaaka; tekatsi ñeeroni eejatzi.
Eeniro akemapiintawitari chapinki piyompiwaetawitacharini, omampaawaeteeyawitacharini, showitawaetawitacharini, tziwootawaetawitacharini; omaanta iinja tekatsi kemaerini.
Eeniro naawita chapinki wetsikayitawitaworini oetarikapaeni, omaanta iroñaaka tekatsi.
Tee akemaeri iroñaaka toonkirori rowaetari, tok, tok, tok.
Eero otziwootaa eejatzi itziwoomento;
eero ijeekae eejatzi aatsini iina.
Paerani riyotakoeyakirini riraga pimantayitatsirini janta Wawirooniyaki, osheki ipiyotakiri iyorikite. Riraga jeekatsiripaeni ramatawiteeyakirini jeekatsiri paashinipaeniki kipatsi,

eejatzi rowamaakaanteeyakirini maawaeni kamanantayitzirorini iñaani Tajorentsi, eejatzi maawaeni aapatziyaririni Tajorentsi, eejatzi paashinipaeni owamagaetsiri jaka kipatsiki; rootaki ithonkanteeyemirini Tajorentsi maawaeni eerokapaeni wawirooniyajatzi”.
